plugins.name: judicial-voice
plugins.description: Draft or rewrite client correspondence and advice so it reads with the clarity, measured tone and disciplined vocabulary of senior Australian judges (High Court, and the Queensland, NSW and Victorian appeal and supreme courts). Borrows how the judges write, not what they write. For client letters, emails and advice memos, not for writing judgments.
